title: Event teaser with 3-2-1 countdown (9:16)
description: A 12-second vertical hype teaser for an event: a kicker and the event name slam in over an energetic motif, a diagonal wipe cuts to a countdown (3-2-1 digits that slam in with ring bursts and confetti while the ground swaps colour), and a second wipe reveals the poster lockup with the date in an accent block, the place with a pin and a call-to-action pill. Code-rendered (scene.event-countdown) with a procedural pulse bed, whooshes on the wipes and hits on every countdown beat.

kicker.description: Short hype line above the name, 2-4 words, at most 24 characters (e.g. 'Save the date'); different from the call to action; no claims the brief does not make

event.description: Event name exactly as written in the brief, at most 32 characters

date.description: Date, including the time when the brief gives one, exactly as written in the brief, at most 30 characters

place.description: Venue and/or city (or 'Online') exactly as written in the brief, at most 40 characters

cta.description: Call to action exactly as written in the brief (the approved wording), at most 24 characters

look.description: Look: voltage (black, acid lime, hot pink, stripes), sunset (dark, orange, yellow, blocks), pool (deep teal, aqua, coral, rings), poster (paper, red, blue, blocks)

scene.description: The teaser animation; rendered from the copy unless supplied

music.description: Music bed; produced procedurally unless a cleared track is supplied

impact.description: Hit on each countdown beat and on the reveal

click.description: Click as the call-to-action pill pops

copy_examples.brief: Hype reel for Bassline Block Party, an outdoor dance night on Sat 9 August, 8pm at Pier 4, Rotterdam. Call to action: Tickets on sale now
copy_examples.note: Event, date with its time, place and the call to action are copied exactly from the brief; the kicker is a short hype line with no claims the brief does not make.

style.typography: Inter Display Black for the name, date and digits; Inter for kicker, place and button

direction.action: Name slam, wipe, three countdown hits, wipe, poster lockup with date, place and call to action held to the end

notes: The animation is code (recipes/scene/event-countdown) rendered frame-exactly on a virtual clock.
Event name, date, place and the call to action are VERBATIM: copied from the brief, never invented, computed or reformatted. If the brief lacks one, the job is incomplete.
Copy is fitted with measured glyphs and kept inside the 9:16 safe band (below the top 12%, above the bottom 22%); the motif is clipped to a region outside the copy so it never crosses text.
Sound cues at 30 fps: whooshes on the wipes (centred on frames 101 and 196), hits on the countdown beats (frames 106, 137, 167) and on the reveal (196), a click as the call-to-action pill pops (223).

quality_gates.description: Integrated loudness lands within 1 LU of the -14 LUFS delivery target.
Decoded true peak stays at or below -0.5 dBTP after AAC encoding.
No stretch of blank picture (no visible contrast, any colour) lasts longer than 0.5 seconds.
The organiser confirms the event name, date, time, place and call to action are correct and approved.
A reviewer confirms the kicker makes no claim the organiser has not approved (line-ups, sell-outs, prices).
